description: This file defines the Vault class with methods for creating, clearing, deleting, unlocking, changing password, locking notes, and vault management, utilizing dialogs, database interactions, and internationalized strings.

classes.name: Vault
classes.description: A class providing static methods for vault management, including creation, deletion, unlocking, password change, and note locking/unlocking.

methods.name: createVault
methods.description: Creates a new vault after checking if it exists, prompts for password, and shows success toast.

methods.name: clearVault
methods.description: Clears the vault after verifying its existence, prompts for password.

methods.name: deleteVault
methods.description: Deletes the vault after verifying existence, prompts for password and confirmation to delete all locked notes.

methods.name: unlockVault
methods.description: Unlocks the vault by prompting for password.

methods.name: changeVaultPassword
methods.description: Changes the vault password after verifying old password, prompts for new password, and shows success toast.

methods.name: unlockNote
methods.description: Unlocks a specific note by ID after prompting for password.

methods.name: lockNote
methods.description: Locks a note by ID, handling errors such as no vault or vault locked, with retries.

methods.name: askPassword
methods.description: Generic method to prompt for password and execute an action with it.

methods.name: lockVault
methods.description: Locks the vault and shows a success toast.
